review_findings: The Composer is a pure transform that ends at compile_workflow_declaration, so WorkflowSpec and workflow_graph_contract retain runtime authority.
Explicit before-step and after-route anchors prevent hook names from becoming hidden topology semantics.
The base Workflow and Skill contracts remain immutable; the derived plan records all source digests and resolved ordering.
Mutating extensions cannot upgrade a READ_ONLY Workflow, and capability propagation does not replace runtime write guards.
The path set is limited to composition authoring, tests, schema, and documentation.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: the transformed harness-workflow@1 declaration is accepted only after the existing Authoring Core invokes parse_workflow_spec and workflow_graph_contract
mutating extension compatibility is a compile-time prerequisite while WorkflowAdapterDispatcher and existing guards retain execution authority
the Composer preserves the base completion block byte-for-semantics and recompiles it through the existing completion checks
composition is added upstream without changing runtime, providers, TaskRun, or customer product code
